units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 23:30">Targ. Prov. XXIII, 30</cite> <he>בית מ׳</he> drinking house (h. text <cite ref="M01674"><he>ממִסך</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Nedarim 55a:2">Ned. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>הדין מי׳ דמי וכ׳</he> this prepared wine tastes like that prepared by &c.; <cite ref="Eruvin 54a:19">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>דמי האי מזיגא וכ׳</he>.

B. Mets. 60ᵃ מ׳ דידי מידע ידיע wine which I mixed is easily distinguished (because I make it very weak).—Trnsf. מ׳ דעלמא the banquet of the world, the needs of life. Cant. R. to VII, 4; [Matt. K.: מָזְגָּא the butler of the world (the Lord)].—Pl. מִזְגֵּי, v. next w.
